message.content:
Looking at panels E and F (the AV subepicardial mesenchyme) across the three time points, the cardiac neural crest markers (ISL1, pink ×; ALDH1A1, green +) are essentially absent at 4.5–5 PCW but appear in greater numbers by 6.5 PCW and 9 PCW. Thus cardiac neural crest cells become present in this region between 4.5–5 and 6.5 PCW.

[ANSWER]C[/ANSWER]
